findings: Gramota’s 2025 answer and its dictionary paradigm support договоры as the written standard and договора as conversational. The article adds professional frequency, origin, social/register distribution and examples that these brief normative sources do not establish.

limitations: Las fuentes localizadas respaldan únicamente partes acotadas y no verifican todas las afirmaciones materiales, ejemplos ni equivalencias de traducción.
